title: Senior cloud solutions architect
description: A 10-year AWS solutions architect with heavy pre-sales and IaC experience evaluated against 8 postings: one strong principal-architect match with multi-cloud/Kubernetes gaps, one semantic match written with zero vendor keywords, one marginal hands-on platform role, and five distractors.
rationale: j2 is the semantic-no-keyword-overlap case: it describes exactly this resume's job — designing large-scale distributed systems on a major public cloud, guiding enterprise customers through technical evaluations, defining environments as declarative version-controlled configuration — while deliberately naming no vendor or tool the resume lists (no AWS, Terraform, CloudFormation, EC2, Lambda). TF-IDF gets almost no signal; embeddings should rank it high. Gap target j1 overlaps heavily on AWS, Terraform, distributed systems design, and pre-sales (justifying grade 3) while requiring Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure the resume clearly lacks (high) and preferring GCP and Ansible (low). j4 probes the graded boundary: real Terraform/AWS overlap, but the core of the role is hands-on Kubernetes/Go/GitOps platform operations rather than architecture or client-facing work. The remaining jobs are engineering and go-to-market distractors, including a quota-carrying sales role that superficially echoes the resume's pre-sales vocabulary.

jobs.raw_text:
Principal Cloud Solutions Architect — Helios Digital (Remote, US)

Helios Digital is a 400-person consultancy delivering cloud transformation programs for Fortune 1000 clients. We are hiring a Principal Cloud Solutions Architect to anchor our multi-cloud practice.

What you will do:
- Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise transformation deals
- Architect multi-region distributed systems on AWS and Azure for regulated clients
- Own reference architectures and reusable Terraform blueprints across the practice
- Support account executives in pre-sales calls, proposals, and executive briefings

Requirements: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, distributed systems design. 8+ years in cloud infrastructure or solution architecture roles, 3+ years in a customer-facing pre-sales or consulting capacity, hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production. Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field; AWS or Azure professional-level certification.

Nice to have: Google Cloud Platform, Ansible, service mesh experience (Istio).

Enterprise Technology Advisor — Bluewater Advisory (Hybrid, New York NY)

Bluewater Advisory helps large companies modernize how their software runs. We deliberately avoid listing product names in our postings — we care whether you can reason about systems, not recite vendor glossaries.

You will design large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems on a major public cloud platform for enterprise clients, guide prospective customers through technical evaluations, workshops, and proof-of-value engagements, define environment provisioning as declarative, version-controlled configuration, and advise client leadership on reliability, security posture, and spend governance.

We look for deep experience with at least one major public cloud provider, a track record designing fault-tolerant multi-region systems, fluency defining environments as declarative version-controlled configuration, and consultative communication with executive stakeholders. 8+ years across infrastructure and client-facing advisory work. Bonus: regulated-industry experience, public speaking at industry events.

Kestrel Robotics builds autonomous inspection drones for utility companies. We need a firmware engineer for our flight-control team.

Requirements: C and C++, an RTOS (FreeRTOS or Zephyr), ARM Cortex-M targets, hardware debugging with JTAG and logic analyzers. 3+ years of embedded development. Bonus: PX4 or ArduPilot experience.
